entities.span: Click a result through to the real posting on the source site, and record that you applied.
No auto fill and nothing submitted on the user's behalf.
Minimal here: the guided capture questions arrive later, in v2.
This closes the thread and makes the application record the only place a job persists.
**Done when:** a result links out to the real posting in a new tab,
marking it applied writes a record tied to that user,
the record survives a reload,
and the same job applied to twice does not silently create a duplicate.
An apply by a user with no profile row fails visibly as an expected failure rather than as a raw database error
rejected_spans: (spec 0003's Follow-up asked for this criterion and it was missing until spec 0014 added it)

entities.span: Marking a job applied spends no Adzuna call, on a fresh session and on an expired one alike.
Also, this feature moves its own claim (`application tracking`) from planned to working in the entry page's "What's real today" card (spec 0006, **AC-8**).
Owed a decision on the predicted salary flag, recorded from spec 0013 on 2026-09-04.
`application` gains a nullable `salary_is_predicted` column paired to the salary by a check constraint, written `null` rather than `false` when Adzuna stated no pay at all.
rejected_spans: This closes the matching Follow-up items in specs 0003 and 0013, both of which named this feature as the one that had to decide, and both now ticked.

entities.span: Design it (spec): 0014

Build it: `/develop apply redirect & application record` · all five milestones done 2026-09-05, code in `src/features/applications/`, `src/lib/adzuna.ts`, `src/lib/listing-format.ts`, `src/components/adzuna-attribution.tsx`, `src/lib/supabase/read-only-cookies.ts`, `src/proxy.ts` and `supabase/migrations/20260905120000_application_salary_is_predicted.sql`.
rejected_spans: The last milestone closed only after `/check verify` found AC-10 genuinely failing on an expired session and `/debug` traced it to the proxy rather than to this feature's own code; see Close out

entities.span: Schema and shared code · done 2026-09-05. Migration applied to local and the schema confirmed live, not just generated; the pairing check was **proved with real inserts** (three valid states accepted, a flag with no salary and a salary with no flag both refused, all rolled back). The relocation landed at `src/components/`, not `src/components/ui/` as the spec's table says (AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-13, AC-15)
rejected_spans: that directory's own AGENTS.md defines it as spec 0005's design system, and a vendor licence attribution is not a design system primitive

entities.span: The thin thread · done 2026-09-05, proved end to end against the real stack by 14 integration tests: one apply writes one row carrying all eleven snapshot fields, `profile_id` comes from verified claims, and the three timestamps come from the database. (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-19, AC-20)

Failure surface and removal · done 2026-09-05. Duplicate and missing profile both refused by the database and both turned into their own visible expected failure, driven for real. The catch now lives in `ApplyControl` around the call, which is the only place left, and the client side recovery is **not browser verified** (AC-4, AC-5, AC-11, AC-21)
rejected_spans: **AC-21 was found unimplementable where the spec put it**: a production server answering a stale request logs `Failed to find Server Action` and rejects the dispatch *before* any of this feature's code runs, so `recordApplication` can never catch it.

entities.span: The full applications screen and the applied marker · done 2026-09-05, with 20 new component and page tests. `/applications` finally does what its own copy has promised on production since feature 32. Both attributions render per row and none at all on an empty page; a failed marker read says so (`COPY-8`) (AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-17, AC-18)
rejected_spans: rather than rendering twenty unmarked cards, which would have claimed the reader had applied to none of them

entities.span: Close out · **done 2026-09-05**. Done earlier that day: the four spans registered in `spans.md`, and the entry page claim moved from `planned` to `working`. Fixed by `/debug`, locked by proxy-action-refresh.test.ts which was proved to fail without the fix, recorded by `/architect` as spec 0014 **AC-20a**, spec 0008 **AC-10b** and a third item on spec 0001's binding rule 6, then re-measured end to end: counter flat across an expired session apply, row landed, no `x-action-revalidated`. The stale build case (AC-21) was measured the same way and passes (AC-10, AC-12, AC-14, AC-16, AC-20a, AC-21)
rejected_spans: its guard test failed first, which is what feature 7's equivalent lacked when it went unmet for two days

entities.span: Verify it: `/check verify apply redirect & application record` · done 2026-09-05, run twice.
